summary: This file defines static enumeration data (TokenKinds) mapping libclang CXTokenKind values to names. It contains no callable functions, classes, or methods — only a list of tuples exported via __all__.
TokenKinds: list of tuples mapping CXTokenKind enumeration values (PUNCTUATION, KEYWORD, IDENTIFIER, LITERAL, COMMENT) to their integer codes in libclang
note: No callable APIs present. This is a data-only module providing static enumeration definitions for libclang token kinds.
